comparison.objective: Place a cable plug in a holder while keeping the entire cable clear of a hot-plate zone.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body deformable routing and hazard avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Plug seated and released, cable on the table and at least 5 cm from the disc; any cable/plug overlap with the disc at any time forces zero.
comparison.reason: The central ability is safe cable routing around a keep-out region, not rigid precision impact, notch fracture, or small-fragment retrieval.
